title: Plug & Prosper Is Out
body:
Plug & Prosper is out now on itch.io.

I made this cozy plug-and-cable puzzle for the jam, then took my actual entry in another direction. I still liked how it turned out, so I finished and released it anyway.

[video: Plug & Prosper release trailer showing the plug-and-cable puzzle gameplay.](../media/plug-charge-2026-08-02-plug-and-prosper-is-out/plug-and-prosper-trailer-itch.mp4)

[Play Plug & Prosper](https://smallloopworks.itch.io/plug-prosper) · [Watch the trailer](https://youtu.be/Ml5cqs1ab0Y)
